meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析RNA-seq数据来发现基因间的调控连接
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target gene relationships from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover regulatory interactions from RNA-seq data

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 可调用 arboreto 库，从基因表达数据（如 bulk 或单细胞 RNA-seq）推断基因调控网络，识别转录因子与靶基因的调控关系，并输出 TF、target、importance 三列结果。同时支持用 Dask 做本地多核或集群分布式计算。
howto.when: 当用户提供转录组表达数据（如 bulk RNA-seq、单细胞 RNA-seq），要求推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系或构建调控网络时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GRNBoost2 从这个表达矩阵推断基因调控网络。
用 GENIE3 比较一下这些基因的调控关系，并过滤重要性大于 0.5 的连接。
say.note: 运行 GENIE3 并给出高置信度的调控链接。

say.text: 对这几个条件下的表达数据分别推断调控网络，设置随机种子 42。
say.note: 按条件循环运行 grnboost2，生成各条件下的网络文件。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to use arboreto to infer gene regulatory networks from expression data (bulk/single-cell RNA-seq), producing TF–target–importance links, with optional Dask distribution across cores or clusters.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze transcriptomics data (e.g., bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to infer transcription factor–target gene regulatory links or build a gene regulatory network.

say_en.text: Use GRNBoost2 to infer a gene regulatory network from this expression matrix.
say_en.note: Calls grnboost2 and returns TF, target, importance results.

say_en.text: Compare regulatory links with GENIE3 and filter importance > 0.5.
say_en.note: Runs GENIE3 and outputs high-confidence regulatory links.

say_en.text: Infer regulatory networks for each condition separately with seed 42.
say_en.note: Loops grnboost2 per condition and generates network files.
